titleEn: Breathe Out Until Your Ears Come Down!

pages.text: "That's my place!" Mina stamped on the yard platform. A cool evening breeze had brought everyone outside. The river lay low, far below.
"The end is where you can see the whole river!" Raju, the experienced eldest, already sat there. Mina's ears spread wide.
Mina shouted and kicked the platform. Startled, Raju got up. The cool yard became quiet.
Mom sat snugly beside Mina. "Something hot rose in your chest, didn't it?" "...Yes." Mina nodded, shoulders moving.
"Your ears show anger first. They spread like this." Mom touched them gently. "Oh, they really are spread!" Mina felt their ears, too.
"Breathe in through your trunk, let your belly puff out. Then breathe out through your mouth." Mina copied. In, out. "My ears are coming down! Breathe Out Until Your Ears Come Down!"
Mina approached Raju. "Sorry I shouted. I was angry enough to spread my ears." "It's okay." Raju moved over a handspan.
Mom looked at them sitting together at the end. "Two can see the whole river from there." Mina's and Raju's shoulders touched.
The next day, Raju sat at the end again. Mina took a big breath in and out. "Let's sit together again today."
Mom put her arms around both children. Cool river wind touched their faces. "Let's sit together again today." Mina smiled.
